name: Band Squat
steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and bring the ends up to your shoulders.
Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and turn your toes slightly outward.
Bend your hips and knees together to squat down until your thighs reach roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive evenly through both feet to stand upright against the increasing tension of the band.
tips: Track both knees in line with your toes throughout the descent and ascent.
Keep your heels planted flat on the floor rather than shifting onto your toes.
